neighbours.label: The passive participle saying what happens to the winners of a giveaway or contest (winners will be contacted / announced / notified), vs announcements in the same style about meetings, schedules or products
fire: To enter, leave a comment below; the lucky winner will be chosen at random and contacted by Monday.
Our photo contest closes Sunday night, and finalists will be announced on the blog next week.
Thanks for entering the raffle! Winners will be notified by phone before the weekend.
This sweepstakes ends June 30, and the grand prize winner will be announced on July 2.
Share the post to enter the giveaway; three winners will be contacted through direct message.
Voting for the recipe challenge runs until Friday, with the winner announced at the fair.
The drawing takes place at noon, and every winner will be emailed a confirmation code.
Submit your best caption by midnight; the winning entry will be revealed in Thursday's newsletter.
quiet: To join the club, leave your name at the desk; the schedule will be printed and handed out by Monday.
Our book club meets Sunday night, and next month's title will be discussed on the blog next week.
Thanks for attending the lecture! Slides will be uploaded to the website before the weekend.
This road closure lasts until June 30, and the detour route will be marked with orange signs.
Share your feedback on the survey; three questions will be added to the next version.
Construction on the library runs until Friday, with the doors reopened on Monday morning.
The meeting starts at noon, and every attendee will be given a printed agenda.
Send your questions by midnight; the answers will be published in Thursday's newsletter.

predictions: Fire 0.35-0.85 on contacted/announced/notified after 'winner(s) will be'; near misses under 0.15. A contest sentence about prizes being shipped scored 0.251, so near misses avoid contest wording.
notes: Card: ' announced' x3, contacted, winner context. Probe: 'winners will be contacted via email' 0.847, 'the winner will be announced on May 4' 0.772, 'winner announced shortly after' 0.424, 'Winners will be notified' 0.374; 'prizes will be shipped' 0.251; 'minutes will be posted online' 0.048, 'mayor was announced as the winner of the election' 0.051.
